name: Eurodollar PLNY
oneLiner: PLNY is Eurodollar ApS's unissued Polish zloty e-money token, with a deployed Ethereum contract and proposed par redemption.
collateral: The white paper proposes 1:1 PLN reserve backing and segregated customer funds. No tokens have been issued; a token-specific reserve composition, named reserve banks and independent reserve report are not published on the reviewed issuer verification page.
pegMechanism: Each PLNY is intended to be a claim on Eurodollar ApS for one Polish zloty, redeemable at par under the notified e-money token terms. The issuer describes ordinary redemption without a fee, minimum or holding period, subject to required checks. Ethereum contract deployment does not establish issuance or a live market.
launchPhaseDetail: The issuer states that the Ethereum smart contract is deployed but no PLNY tokens have been issued. Its white paper is dated 11 February 2026, with a management disclosure correction on 9 October 2026. Olbra markets the same deployment under the same company number and LEI; the ESMA register and GLEIF still name Eurodollar ApS. No launch date is stated.

milestones.title: PLNY white paper records notification to Finanstilsynet
milestones.description: The issuer publishes terms for its Polish zloty e-money token. This is a white-paper notification, not public token issuance or approval of the white paper.
